mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate at 0.2% is at a historically low level, signaling an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 9.5%) signals a weak labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and housing starts (HOUST < 650) signals a contraction in the real economy, increasing equity risk and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 AND HOUST < 650.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by INDPRO > 105 and UNRATE < 5.0%), the S&P 500 is vulnerable to correction due to overvaluation and rising interest rate expectations, leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105 AND UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1 < 13200) signals a recession, reducing corporate earnings and increasing equity risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 13200.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing short-term interest rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of residential sales (RSAFS > 360000) signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 360000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST > 650) and residential sales (RSAFS > 360000) signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 650 AND RSAFS > 360000.
